summary: All 7 acceptance-matrix criteria exercised via 6 backend test files (pytest, run over the https APP_URL ingress since the session cookie is Secure=True and only survives over TLS) and 5 browser checks. The user-reported login bug (criterion 1) did NOT reproduce over the real https path: register -> onboarding -> logout -> login with the same real credentials correctly lands on /app/dashboard and stays there (verified with a 3s settle + reload). No app bugs found.
action_items: note: reproducing the reported login-bounce bug requires testing through the https APP_URL ingress, not plain http://localhost:8001 or :3000 — the backend sets the session cookie Secure=True whenever APP_URL starts with https (lib/auth.py create_session), so a plain-http client/browser will never re-attach it. All browser checks and 2 of the 3 backend test files were pointed at https://cliente-pro-1.preview.emergentagent.com for this reason. If a future browser/backend test run defaults to localhost, this exact class of check will report a false bug.
note: one browser check run (logout-confirm-cancel-flow) hit a transient 429 rate-limit against the ingress on first attempt and passed cleanly on immediate rerun — classified flaky, not a bug.

checks.criterion: BUG RELATADO: login com conta real aceita credenciais mas volta para /login
checks.name: real-account-login-persists
checks.evidence: Registered tscheck-login-<ts>@example.com, onboarded, logged out via confirm dialog, logged back in with same email/password -> URL settled on /app/dashboard with kpi-grid visible, remained there after a 3s wait. Screenshots: login-filled, dashboard-after-real-login, dashboard-still-there.

checks.criterion: BUG RELATADO: login com conta real (API-level cookie roundtrip)
checks.name: test_register_onboarding_logout_login_session_roundtrip
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/register -> 200; POST /api/auth/onboarding -> 200 onboarded=true; POST /api/auth/logout -> 200; GET /api/auth/session -> 200 null; POST /api/auth/login -> 200; GET /api/auth/session -> 200 with matching email/owner_name; GET /api/dashboard -> 200. Run against https://cliente-pro-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api (Secure cookie requires TLS).

checks.name: signup-onboarding-dashboard
checks.evidence: Filled /cadastro form, submitted -> /onboarding; completed 4 steps (business_name, owner_name, segment via onboarding-segment-Consultoria, phone) -> landed on /app/dashboard with kpi-grid visible and page-title containing 'Tester' (first name of owner_name 'Tester QA').

checks.criterion: Sessão persistente após reload em várias rotas
checks.name: session-persists-reload
checks.evidence: After signup+onboarding, page.reload() on /app/dashboard kept URL+kpi-grid; navigated to /app/clientes and reloaded, URL stayed; navigated to /app/configuracoes and reloaded, URL stayed.

checks.criterion: Proteção das rotas privadas sem sessão
checks.name: route-protection-no-session
checks.evidence: Fresh context, direct goto('/app/dashboard'|'/app/clientes'|'/app/pagamentos') each redirected to /login. Console showed the expected 3x 401 on /api/auth/session / /api/dashboard, which is the guard working as designed.

checks.criterion: Proteção das rotas privadas sem sessão (API-level 401)
checks.name: test_protected_endpoints_require_session
checks.evidence: GET /api/dashboard, /api/clients, /api/payments, /api/auth/me with no cookie jar each returned 401; GET /api/auth/session (non-throwing probe) returned 200 + null.

checks.criterion: Logout só encerra a sessão com confirmação explícita
checks.name: logout-confirm-cancel-flow
checks.evidence: First attempt hit a transient 429 from the ingress during signup and failed before any app assertion; immediate rerun passed cleanly: mobile-logout-button opened logout-confirm-dialog; logout-cancel-button kept user on /app/dashboard with kpi-grid visible; a second logout via logout-confirm-button redirected to /login; subsequent goto('/app/dashboard') also redirected to /login.

checks.criterion: Isolamento entre contas: dados não vazam entre usuários
checks.name: data-isolation-empty-state
checks.evidence: New real account: /app/dashboard kpi-grid showed zero-state, /app/clientes showed clientes-empty-state. Switched to demo@clientepro.com/demo1234: clientes-empty-state hidden, clientes-list rendered exactly 9 client-card-* rows.

checks.name: test_new_account_has_no_clients_and_zero_dashboard / test_demo_account_keeps_its_own_nine_clients
checks.evidence: New account: GET /api/clients -> [] ; GET /api/dashboard -> clientes_ativos=0, vencidos=0, proximos_vencimentos=[]. demo@clientepro.com login -> GET /api/clients -> 200 with len()==9.

checks.criterion: Rejeição de login com senha incorreta (auth validation)
checks.name: test_login_wrong_password_rejected
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login with a freshly-registered email but wrong password -> 401.

checks.criterion: Nenhum erro de console / requisição falhando durante o fluxo autenticado
checks.name: covered inline across all browser checks above
checks.evidence: Every browser check's console_errors only ever showed the expected 401 on /api/auth/session or /api/dashboard immediately after logout / while unauthenticated (explicitly called out as non-bug in the briefing). No other console errors or >=400 responses observed during signup, onboarding, login, reloads, or navigation across dashboard/clientes/pagamentos/configuracoes.
